note: The 1901 household at Felixstowe, Clumber Road West (#394) — eleven people, none in the record. The house is demolished and the record held only its 1911 household, the Dowsons, so this is the earlier family. Schedule 178 on a page that runs Clumber Crescent, 6 Clumber Road, Felixstowe, Clumber Road — which is what places it at #394. Servant birthplaces are deliberately omitted: see the source note on each.
